title: workspace-kinds.json
description: Member kinds a plugin supplies (#2524 D3, #2535, ws-031). A package publishes this file as data at its ./workspace-kinds subpath. chant reads it with the file system and never imports the package, so reading kinds never loads a lexicon.

$schema.description: An editor hint. chant ignores it.

$comment.description: A note for people. chant ignores it.

name.description: The kind's name, as a member's kind field names it. chant, workspace, other and examples are built in and can't be supplied.

description.description: One line saying what the member's directory holds, for listings and error messages.

precedence.description: When the probes of several kinds claim one directory, the highest precedence decides. Two claiming kinds with the same highest precedence are a tie, and a tie fails. The built-in chant kind has 500 and workspace has 1000.

outputs.description: The outputs every member of this kind exposes as link targets (#2524 D6, #2539). A member entry of the kind may list more in its own outputs field. Without this field the kind exposes only what each entry lists.

probe.description: What the probe checks in a member's directory. It runs no code. It passes when any of its clauses does, and it needs at least one.

anyFile.description: The directory passes when a file matching one of these names sits directly in it. A * in a name matches any run of characters, so *.tf matches every Terraform file.

anyBlock.description: The directory passes when a file directly in it, whose name matches one of in, has a line opening an unlabelled block named in blocks: leading space, the name, optional space, then {. No file is parsed.

anyJsonKey.description: The directory passes when a file directly in it, whose name matches one of in, parses as JSON and has a value at one of pointers, each a JSON Pointer such as /scripts/start (#3151). A file that is not JSON is no evidence either way. Added by chant 0.103.0.

fileName.description: A file name, with no directory part. A * matches any run of characters.

graph.description: How chant workspace graph reads a member of this kind (#2874). chant writes a reader project of its own outside the workspace, with a chant.config.json that declares lexicon and puts config under that lexicon's key, and runs the member's chant graph there. In every string key and value of config, {member} becomes the member's name, {dir} its absolute directory and {workspace} the absolute workspace root. Without this field a member of the kind is listed with kind-not-run.

lexicon.description: The lexicon that reads the member, by name. The package that supplies the kind must be @intentius/chant-lexicon-<lexicon>, so the lexicon chant loads is the one the declaration pins.

config.description: The lexicon's config namespace for the reader project, such as terraform's roots. Placeholders are substituted; nothing else is interpreted.

fields.description: The fields a member entry of this kind may set under its own fields block, each with a type and, optionally, a default (#3151). chant workspace check fails a member whose fields name one the kind doesn't declare or give a value of the wrong type (WSP005), and chant workspace status --json prints every declared field with the defaults filled in. Added by chant 0.103.0; an older chant can't read a kinds file that uses it.

default.description: The value a member that doesn't set the field gets. Its type is the field's. Without it the field reads as null when unset.

pattern.description: For a string field: a regular expression the value must match.

properties.description: The object's own fields, each a string, integer or boolean field. A member sets any of them; the rest take their defaults.
